name: prr_scout
description: Proposes review rules for one repository from its own rule files and the review comments on its merged pull requests: one checkable sentence each, with its scope, severity and the words it came from. Everything it proposes waits for a person to accept it.

files.description: Rule files read at the default branch: {path, kind, scope, lines}.

comments.description: Review comments on merged pull requests: {id, pr, who, path, body}.

existing.description: Rules this Lemma already has: {id, text, state, source}.

text.description: One sentence a reviewer can check from a diff, in the team's own words.

file.description: For a file rule: the path it was read from.

line.description: For a file rule: the line its words start on.

summary.description: Two or three plain sentences on what was found.
